projects.name: Autonomous Navigation System
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive autonomous navigation system for mobile robots using SLAM algorithms and deep learning. The system integrates LiDAR, camera sensors, and IMU data to create real-time mapping and path planning capabilities.

projects.name: Computer Vision Pipeline
projects.description: Built an end-to-end computer vision pipeline for industrial quality control, achieving 99.2% accuracy in defect detection. Implemented custom CNN architectures and deployed the system on edge devices.

projects.name: Robotic Arm Control
projects.description: Designed and implemented inverse kinematics solver and trajectory planning algorithms for a 6-DOF robotic arm. Integrated force feedback control for delicate manipulation tasks.
